Content: The functions of the loci of the `text(lac)` operon shown in the diagram are described in the table below.

The diagram above represents a segment of the E. coli chromosome that contains the `text(lacI)` gene and part of the `text(lac)` operon, a coordinately regulated set of genes that are required for the metabolism of lactose. The presence of lactose, which causes the repressor to be released from the operator, results in increased transcription of the `text(lac)` operon.
